title: Haider hu mai haider
body:
Haider hu mai haider
Ya ali maula, maula ya ali maula..(2)
<<DIVIDER>>
haider haider haider haider
<<MINI>>
Haider hu mai haider..(2)
<<DIVIDER>>
Kehte the ali kufe  me ye barsare mimbar
<<MINI>>
Haider hu mai haider..(2)
<<DIVIDER>>
Hairan hai duniya kyu mere mojize sunkar
<<MINI>>
Haider hu mai haider..(2)
<<DIVIDER>>
1. Suraj mere kehne pe bhala kyu na palat ta
taara meri dehleez pe kaise na utarta
maine hi jalae..(2) the bujha deta mai yaksar
<<MINI>>
Haider hu mai haider..(4)
<<DIVIDER>>
2. Mai ghaib hu duniya ko ye idraak nahi hai
haan mujhpe kisi naam ka iflaak nahi hai
bus mujhko samajhte..
bus mujhko samajh sakte hai allah, payambar
<<MINI>>
Haider hu mai haider..(4)
<<DIVIDER>>
3. Hai rabb ki sadaqat ke hawale mere basme
qur'aan me allah ne khai mere qasme
'La Raib' laqab hai..(2) mera qur'aan ke andar
<<MINI>>
Haider hu mai haider..(4)
<<DIVIDER>>
4. Is baat ki qudrat hai faqat mere qalam me
tasweer banata hu mai madar ke shikam me
takhleeq pe khaliq..(2) ne kiya mujhko muqarrar
<<MINI>>
Haider hu mai haider..(4)
<<DIVIDER>>
5. Gar qatl kiya jau to mai qatl na hunga
so(100) baar bhi maut aegi hargiz na marunga
bebas hai mere saamne..(2) ye maut ka chakkar
<<MINI>>
Haider hu mai haider..(4)
<<DIVIDER>>
6. Pohche sare meraj nabi jis ghadi logo
bas haath milaane ka waha izn tha mujhko
jee kar ta tha kehdu..(2) mai ye parde se nikalkar
<<MINI>>
Haider hu mai haider..(4)
<<DIVIDER>>
7. Maa ne kabhi marhab ki ye marhab se kaha tha
tu laakh bahadur hai magar usse na ladna
maidan me aajae..(2) agar koi ye kehkar
<<MINI>>
Haider hu mai haider..(4)
<<DIVIDER>>
8. Tum kisko darate ho yu naam apne batake
wo aur the maidan se jo bhaag gae the
mai aam sahabi..(2) nahi ae marhab o antar
<<MINI>>
Haider hu mai haider..(2)
<<DIVIDER>>
9. Jo log samajhte hai mai wallah nahi hu
bus jaanlo sab kuch hu mai allah nahi hu
mabood hai akbar..(2) wo mera khaliq e akbar
<<MINI>>
Haider hu mai haider..(4)
Ya ali maula, maula ya ali maula..(3)
<<DIVIDER>>
author: Mir Hassan Mir
